# hivelocity_vps_volume (Resource)

Creates an additional block storage volume attached to a VPS instance. Volumes are billed monthly. Changing `size` grows the volume in place; changing `device_id` moves it to another instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_vps_volume" "data" {
  device_id = hivelocity_vps.app.device_id
  size      = 100 # GiB
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the VPS instance the volume is attached to.
- `size` (Number) Size of the volume in GiB.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the volume was created.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the volume.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the volume in bytes as reported by the API.
- `type` (String) `ROOT` or `DATADISK`.
- `volume_id` (String) Unique ID of the volume.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the volume ID
terraform import hivelocity_vps_volume.data vol-abc123
```
